description: React component 'TodoList' displays a list of todo items and handles rendering of individual items via the 'TodoItem' component. It receives an array of todo objects and handler functions as props, rendering a message if the list is empty or a list of 'TodoItem' components otherwise.

methods.name: TodoList({ items, onToggle, onSave, onDelete })
methods.description: Functional React component rendering a list of todos or a message if the list is empty.
